kurz: The most important lever in the kitchen. A few degrees decide which process runs and which does not.
bild_im_kopf: Like a staircase: on each step a different door opens.
was_passiert: Every process has its threshold. Protein cooks from about 50 °C; starch [[quellen|swells]] from about 50–65 °C depending on the kind. Connective tissue dissolves from about 70 °C, water evaporates at 100 °C, browning starts from about 140 °C. For meat, the difference between surface and [[kerntemperatur|core temperature]] also matters.
faustregeln: A thermometer is the most valuable tool for better results.
Hot surface, gentle inside: that is almost always the goal with meat.
